title: SOFTWARE TESTER / QA TESTER
description: URGENT REQUIREMENT – SOFTWARE TESTER / QA TESTER 0–1 Year Experience | Freshers with Relevant Knowledge Can Apply Softscholars Technologies is recruiting on behalf of our client concern, R.K. Creators, Gandhipuram, Coimbatore , for the position of Software Tester / QA Tester. We are looking for detail-oriented and technically interested candidates who can test web applications, identify bugs, verify application functionality, and ensure software quality across frontend and backend modules. Job Details Job Title: Software Tester / QA Tester Recruitment Agency: Softscholars Technologies Client Company: R.K. Creators Job Location: Gandhipuram, Coimbatore Qualification: Any Degree (B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT or related disciplines preferred) Experience: 0–1 Year Freshers: Can apply if they have relevant technical knowledge and testing aptitude Salary: Negotiable based on skills and suitability Joining: Immediate / Short Notice Preferred Required Knowledge & Skills Candidates should have basic knowledge or practical exposure to the following: Software Testing Fundamentals Manual Testing Functional Testing Regression Testing UI and Compatibility Testing Web Application Testing Bug Identification and Reporting Test Case and Test Scenario Preparation Basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript Basic understanding of React.js applications API Testing using Postman or similar tools Basic SQL / MySQL database queries Browser Developer Tools Additional Advantage: Knowledge of Automation Testing (Selenium, Playwright or Cypress) Basic understanding of Git and version control Knowledge of Agile / SDLC / STLC Experience testing React.js-based web applications Roles & Responsibilities Perform functional and manual testing of web applications. Test frontend interfaces developed using React.js. Verify application workflows, user interactions, forms, validations and navigation. Identify, document and report software bugs with clear reproduction steps. Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios. Perform regression testing after bug fixes and application updates. Test backend functionality, API responses and database operations. Verify data consistency between frontend, backend and database. Conduct cross-browser and responsive UI testing. Coordinate with developers to understand issues and verify bug fixes. Maintain test documentation and testing reports. Ensure application functionality and quality before deployment. Participate in testing existing applications as well as newly developed features. What We Are Looking For Strong logical thinking and analytical skills. Good observation and attention to detail. Basic understanding of web technologies. Interest in software testing and quality assurance. Ability to identify problems and think of different test scenarios. Willingness to learn new technologies, including React.js-based applications. Good communication and teamwork skills. Responsible attitude towards assigned tasks and deadlines. IMPORTANT – LONG-TERM COMMITMENT This is a full-time, long-term employment opportunity with our client concern, R.K. Creators. It is not a short-term internship or temporary position. Candidates looking only for a few months of experience or temporary employment are requested not to apply. Please apply only if you are genuinely interested in building a stable, long-term career in Software Testing / Quality Assurance. IMPORTANT FOR PREVIOUS APPLICANTS Candidates who have previously applied for the same or similar position through Softscholars Technologies and failed to attend scheduled assessments/interviews, repeatedly postponed interviews, withdrew during the selection process, or were previously not selected are requested not to reapply for this recruitment cycle . Repeated applications from candidates who have already participated in the same recruitment process will not be considered. WALK-IN INTERVIEW Experienced and eligible fresher candidates can walk in directly for an interview. Client Location: R.K. Creators 9th Street, Crosscut Road, Gandhipuram, Coimbatore – 641012. Immediate joining / short-notice candidates are preferred. Resume Submission Send your updated resume to: softscholarshrd@gmail.com Only candidates with genuine interest in software testing, good analytical ability, and a willingness to commit to a long-term employment opportunity should apply. Recruitment handled by: Softscholars Technologies For our Client Concern: R.K. Creators, Gandhipuram, Coimbatore Job Type: Full-time Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month Benefits: Flexible schedule Ability to commute/relocate: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required) Education: Bachelor's (Required) Experience: Software testing: 1 year (Preferred) Language: Tamil (Required) Work Location: In person
